name: RTX CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: RTX Corp. is an aerospace and defense business supplying systems and services to commercial, military and government customers. Its segments are Collins Aerospace Systems, Pratt and Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence and Space, and Raytheon Missiles and Defense. Collins makes aero structures, avionics, interiors and power controls, while Pratt and Whitney designs and builds aircraft engines.
